scopeLimits: No production deployment, live credential or client-account switch.
Stripe receives one fixed gross Price with net/VAT disclosure and metadata; no Stripe Tax accounting or formal VAT invoice is created.
Bank-transfer payments are simulated finance milestones; only two Stripe test payments actually traversed checkout.
Existing price-change, manual confirmation, cancellation/refund and one-time staff-top-up policies remain unchanged.
The separately assessed Stripe app/Flow migration is not implemented.
Browser presentation checks are finite; a requested small viewport was not honoured by the in-app browser, so this run does not claim new mobile-width certification.
Historical dated audit reports and exported Word/PDF/source archives retain their earlier release facts; current maintained Markdown and source are updated.
